summary:
Astroverse – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Astroverse is an interactive, space-themed STEM learning platform designed to help students understand the challenges of planning and managing a space mission. It allows young learners to experience the responsibilities of an astronaut by exploring the process of establishing and managing a lunar or Martian outpost.

The platform makes complex space engineering concepts easier to understand through an engaging, mission-based learning experience. Students explore real-world mission trade-offs, make decisions, and learn how to balance competing requirements while planning a successful space settlement.

By combining interactive gameplay, science, technology, and problem-solving, Astroverse transforms space education into an enjoyable and practical learning experience. Our goal is to inspire the next generation of explorers, scientists, and innovators while developing their curiosity, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.
details:
Astroverse – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Astroverse is an interactive, space-themed STEM learning platform designed to help students understand the challenges of planning and managing a lunar or Martian mission. It provides a mission-training experience where young learners explore space exploration concepts and make decisions while managing limited resources and balancing important engineering trade-offs.

The platform aims to make complex space science concepts easier to understand through an engaging and interactive experience. Students can explore mission scenarios, understand the importance of resource management, and learn how decisions involving crew safety, energy, supplies, and mission objectives can affect the success of a space mission.

Astroverse addresses the challenge of making STEM education both educational and enjoyable. Instead of only presenting theoretical information, it encourages students to think critically, solve problems, make decisions, and understand real-world engineering challenges.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, and other modern web technologies. Firebase is used for application-related services, and NASA data integration supports selected space-related information.

The creativity of Astroverse lies in combining space exploration, interactive learning, and mission-based decision-making into one platform. Its intended impact is to inspire young learners to develop an interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics while building problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.
